headline: Performance Marketing Leadership | DTC Acquisition | Full-Funnel Analytics
headline_rationale: This plaintiff-law-firm growth role demands hands-on Google/Meta expertise, high-volume funnels, CRM and commercial outcomes. Use verified large budgets, consumer acquisition, testing, teams and law-firm marketing without implying plaintiff intake or signed-client results.
summary: Performance marketing leader with hands-on Google and Meta experience, large-budget acquisition and strong funnel analysis. Managed high-volume paid media operations, scaled monthly marketing volume fourfold while improving ROAS from 1.5 to 3.5, and led an eight-person e-commerce team. Evaluated incremental CPA, lifetime value and conversion paths, supported by automated reporting and CRM integration work. Earlier law-firm marketing experience adds context in content strategy, market research and business planning, while keeping growth decisions focused on measurable business outcomes.
